==Background==
{{Quote|I've come to party.<br />Miku-san did me the favor of singing this song; thank you to everyone who helped out with this. See you next year.|Author's comment}}

"'''Oki ni Mesu mama'''" is an orginal song by Eve featuring Hatsune Miku.

This song has entered ''[[Hall of Legend]]''.
